title: Code of Criminal Procedure Sixth Amendment Ordinance 1993

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Sixth Amendment Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1993
CODE OF
CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1993
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the code of Criminal Procedure (Sixth Amendment)
Ordinance, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure Sixth Amendment Ordinance 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 497 Act V of 1898

CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1993
CODE OF
CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (SIXTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE,
1993
2. Amendment of section 497, Act V of 1898.‑‑In
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), in section 497, in
subsection (1),‑‑
(i) in the second proviso, for
the colon at the end a full‑stop shall be substituted; and
(ii) the third and fourth
provisos shall be omitted.
